# Joseph Siroub

**Marketing Management student. Sports business and analytics focused.**

I am a Marketing Management major at Cal Poly Pomona with an Associate of Science in Marketing Management from Mt. San Antonio College. I graduate in one year, and my goal is to work in the sports world through sports media, athlete representation, brand engagement, or agency work.

My background combines marketing coursework, GA4 and R analytics projects, and hands-on operations experience in payroll, compliance documentation, data entry, and cross-functional coordination.
